digest.overview: 今日条目集中在OLED生态的扩张与投入：LG Display以WOLED电竞面板切入中国网吧与电竞酒店场景，韩国通过约2740亿韩元级国家显示研究平台聚焦OLED及后OLED技术，同时上游设备与驱动IC动态显示产业链仍在调整。MicroLED方面，协会成员数量从年初约30家增至55家以上，产业化协作在加强。

news.title_zh: LG Display以WOLED电竞面板瞄准中国网吧，此前三星刚推出QD-OLED网吧计划
news.summary_zh: LG Display表示正在中国扩大WOLED电竞显示器面板供应，面向快速增长的网吧和电竞酒店，并与HKC旗下电竞品牌ANTGAMER以及AOC、ViewSonic、ASUS合作。其供应该场景的面板为24.5英寸WOLED、540Hz刷新率，并在ANTGAMER珠海新品发布上展示了第四代“Primary RGB Tandem”WOLED技术。
news.why: 网吧与电竞酒店成为高端OLED显示器的新体验入口，有望带动WOLED面板需求并加剧与QD-OLED在电竞场景的竞争。

news.summary_zh: MicroLED产业协会（MIA）宣布新增Brillink、PhotonWeave、Pollen、SEICHITECH和UNIPRESS五家成员，成员数量已从2026年初约30家增至55家以上。协会旨在汇聚企业、研究机构和组织，推动MicroLED显示技术采用并促进共性技术问题解决与合作。
news.why: 成员规模快速扩大反映MicroLED产业成熟度提升，有利于产业链协作与共性技术攻关。

news.title_zh: 韩国显示协会欢迎3689亿韩元国家研究平台通过预可行性研究
news.summary_zh: 韩国显示产业界对政府“先进显示国家研究平台构建项目”通过预可行性研究表示欢迎，该项目将在2027年至2033年投入3688.7亿韩元（其中国费2789亿韩元），建设覆盖面板设计、工艺到模组的全流程验证研究基础设施。项目还将建设可支持最高1万ppi的开放式研发基础设施。
news.why: 国家级全流程研发基础设施将强化韩国在高端显示工艺验证与超高像素密度方向的能力，并带动上下游研发协作。

news.title_zh: Naintech向中国TCL CSOT供应OLED传输设备
news.summary_zh: Naintech将向中国TCL CSOT第8.6代喷墨OLED量产线供应基板传输设备，这是其与LG电子6月签署的254亿韩元设备供应合同的后续。该设备为基于真空与氮气的基板物流传输系统，由传输模块、装载锁、缓冲区和传送带等组成，经LG电子供应至TCL CSOT产线。
news.why: 8.6代喷墨OLED量产线设备落地，显示中韩面板与设备供应链在OLED大尺寸化上的联动加深。

news.title_zh: Raydium第三季度OLED驱动IC销售下滑，但预计存储涨价将加速2027年向OLED手机迁移
news.summary_zh: 台湾IC设计公司Raydium公布2026年第三季度业绩，营收2亿美元，环比下降3.8%、同比增长21%，净利润950万美元、环比下降9%。中小尺寸AMOLED驱动IC贡献46%营收约9200万美元，环比约减少10%，手机客户备货结束且终端需求转谨慎，但汽车与工业驱动IC营收占比创纪录达23%。
news.why: 手机OLED驱动IC短期承压，但存储涨价或推动2027年OLED手机渗透加速，同时汽车与工业成为驱动IC厂商的重要支撑。

news.title_zh: 韩国投入2.74亿美元建设新显示研究平台，聚焦OLED与后OLED技术
news.summary_zh: 韩国政府批准新的国家显示研发项目“先进显示国家研究平台”，由产业通商资源部（MOTIR）执行，2027年起为期七年，总预算约2.74亿美元，其中国家预算2.07亿美元，并已通过预可行性研究。平台聚焦“Over OLED”“Cross OLED”“Post OLED”三大技术主题，并将建设覆盖设计到面板全开发周期的测试基础设施。
news.why: 该平台将系统性推进OLED技术深化与后OLED下一代技术布局，巩固韩国显示产业的中长期技术竞争力。

items.title: LG Display targets China's internet cafes with WOLED gaming panels, days after Samsung's QD-OLED cafe program
items.abstract: LG Display says that it is expanding its supply of WOLED gaming monitor panels in China, as local monitor brands chase the country's fast-growing internet cafes and gaming hotels. LGD is working with ANTGAMER, the gaming brand of Chinese panel maker HKC , on its internet cafe business, and it also works with AOC, ViewSonic and ASUS in China. The panel that LGD supplies for these internet cafes is a 24.5-inch WOLED with a 540Hz refresh rate, which suits first-person shooters and other games where split-second reactions matter. LGD hopes that giving gamers a chance to try premium OLED monitors will turn into new demand. The company recently presented its 4th-Gen "Primary RGB Tandem" WOLED technology at ANTGAMER's new product launch in Zhuhai, and says that it will rely on tandem WOLED, its Dynamic Frequency & Resolution (DFR) technology and ultra-high refresh rate panels to grow in the premium gaming monitor market, in China and globally.

items.title: The MicroLED Association welcomes its latest members: Brillink, PhotonWeave, Pollen, SEICHITECH and UNIPRESS
items.abstract: The MicroLED Industry Association (MIA) welcomes its newest members: Brillink, PhotonWeave, Pollen, SEICHITECH and UNIPRESS. The association has grown quickly this year and it now has over 55 members, up from around 30 in early 2026, as interest in microLEDs increases and the industry matures. The MIA aims to accelerate the adoption of microLED display technologies, bringing together companies, researchers and organizations active in the MicroLED industry and providing an ideal forum for solving common technology issues, fostering cooperation and sharing relevant information, resources and tools.

items.title: Raydium's OLED driver sales dip in Q3, but it expects memory prices to speed the shift to OLED phones in 2027
items.abstract: Taiwan-based IC developer Raydium Semiconductor announced its financial results for Q3 2026, with revenues of $200 million, down 3.8% from last quarter and up 21% from Q3 2025. Net profit was $9.5 million, down 9% from last quarter. Small and medium-sized AMOLED driver ICs brought in 46% of revenues, or about $92 million, roughly 10% less than in Q2. Smartphone customers have finished stocking up for new models and end demand has turned cautious, although Raydium says that phone demand fell less than it expected. High-end wearables held up relatively well. Automotive and industrial driver ICs supported the quarter, reaching a record 23% of revenues.

items.title: Korea to fund $274 million into a new display research platform, focused on OLED and post-OLED technologies
items.abstract: The South Korean government has approved a new national display R&D project, the Advanced Display National Research Platform. The project, run by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources (MOTIR), will start in 2027 and run for seven years, with a total budget of around $274 million, of which $207 million will come from the national budget. The project has now passed its preliminary feasibility study, the review that large public R&D projects in Korea must pass before they are funded. The platform will focus on three technology themes. "Over OLED" covers taking today's OLED technologies further, "Cross OLED" covers OLEDs that combine various functions and technologies, and "Post OLED" covers the development of the next-generation display technologies that will follow OLEDs. The project will also build test infrastructure that covers the whole development cycle, from design to panel-level verification.
